description: MASTODON, published by idaholab, models seismic site response and soil-structure interaction using MOOSE, including linear and nonlinear seismic analysis and risk assessment. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is LGPL-2.1-or-later. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: Numerical correctness and compatibility have not been independently tested. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support hazard exposure, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: The provider explicitly identifies MASTODON as an application of platform-moose-multiphysics-framework.
